query: I have a 65‑year‑old man admitted with primary pneumonia. In male inpatients aged 60–70 with primary pneumonia, what is the 75th percentile of the 72‑hour laboratory instability score? Also compare mean critical‑event frequency to all inpatients and report cohort LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY ml.valuenum) AS percentile_75, AVG(CASE WHEN ml.flag = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_critical_events, AVG(ml.los) AS avg_los, AVG(CASE WHEN ml.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_mortality FROM male_labevents_72h_stable ml;
